LanguageData.MWAH.Addon.Tree.Name: trees
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.TreeKissingDesc: Let pawns kiss trees, including loaded mod trees.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.TreeCulturalIntegrationDes: Use the acting pawn’s beliefs at completion. Switch off for basic outcomes; native tree systems stay unchanged.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissTree.OptionTooltip: Kiss {TARGET_label}. A quiet moment beneath the leaves.
LanguageData.MWAH.Settings.CultureUnavailable: Requires Ideology. Basic tree kissing remains available.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissTree.Result.Awkward: {PAWN_labelShort} kissed a tree and felt a little awkward.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Basic.Awkward: Bark against my lips. Somehow I expected a less wooden response.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Affirming.Awkward: My beliefs made this seem less foolish. The bark disagreed.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissTree.Result.Quiet: {PAWN_labelShort} kissed a tree. The tree said nothing.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Basic.Quiet: The tree kept its thoughts to itself. That seems fair.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Affirming.Quiet: I wanted a revelation. The leaves offered a little ordinary silence.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Connected.Quiet: Our bond needed no answer today. I left a kiss anyway.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissTree.Result.Calm: {PAWN_labelShort} found a little calm with a tree.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Basic.Calm: For a moment, there was only shade and the rustle of leaves.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Affirming.Calm: A small kiss, a living tree. Small things can matter.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Connected.Calm: I know this tree, and this quiet felt familiar.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissTree.Result.Rooted: {PAWN_labelShort} left a kiss and felt more grounded.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Basic.Rooted: The tree stayed put. For a little while, so did my worries.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Affirming.Rooted: I have always valued trees. Today I took a moment to show it.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Connected.Rooted: This was not pruning or a ritual. Just a little affection for my own tree.
LanguageData.MWAH.KissTree.Result.Belonging: {PAWN_labelShort} felt at home among the branches.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Basic.Belonging: Roots below, leaves above. For once, I felt exactly where I belonged.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Affirming.Belonging: The canopy felt like company. My affection had somewhere to rest.
LanguageData.MWAH.Fate.Tree.Connected.Belonging: My tree, my quiet place. For this moment, the bond was enough.
